## Gravity-work fixer budget: D, the wall mass and `fixgrav=` (`apply_gravity_work_fixer`) {#sec-ch13-fixgrav}

::: {.callout-note title="Placeholder: waits for chengcli/snapy#303"}
This section will describe the fixer's budget: the per-stage change of $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$, its stage-weighted sum
$D$, the wall-face mass meter and its bound, the deposit of $-D$ as heat, and the `fixgrav=` total on the cycle
line. The gravity-work change in chengcli/snapy#303 moves this code, so the section is written once #303 has
merged and the pin moves. At the pin, the five sums the fixer reduces are formed in `gravity_work_fixer_sums`
([`meshblock.cpp:844-868`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L844-L868)), and the deposit is `apply_gravity_work_fixer`
([`meshblock.cpp:870-911`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L870-L911)). The fixer's physics is @sec-ch06-fixer.
:::
